items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: we had friends up there, Donald and Madeline Griffith

ctx.x: Hoss, H-o-s-s. I told you I had many. She said, 'Hoss, let's go to Providence.' I said, 'Good,' because I heard there was something up there in the Celebrity Club, and we had friends up there, Donald and Madeline Griffith, and we called them up and, see, just like that, I made up my mind, and 6:30 the next morning we was up having coffee, getting ready to take off. I just bought this new car, first '56 Desoto push button. Remember the push button? And I called it -- I bought it for my Dungaree Doll, my daughter.…
